findings.description: Removing the guard that normalizes a path_url beginning with '//' means such paths are passed unchanged to urllib3, which may parse the leading double slash as a network location.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a request to a URL whose path starts with two slashes, such as http://example.com//resource, with no proxy. Previously the code rewrote the path to a single leading slash before it reached urllib3. Now url is the raw '//resource' path, which urllib3 can interpret as a host, so the request may go to the wrong place or fail. The impact is a failed or misdirected request for URLs with a double-slash path.
